Liveness was inspected separately. tests/test.sh:42-58 and :115-124 probe /api/health and then / with 'urlopen(url, timeout=2).read()', 120 iterations and 0.25-second sleeps. The analogous restart loop is at :130-146 and :170-182, preceded by up to five seconds of old-process polling at :155-157; tests/tools/restart_mcp.py:11 and :39 impose an outer 55-second subprocess timeout. I do not claim that the retry count alone proves a conforming app exceeds a budget: environment/instructions/integration.md:5 requires successful prompt health responses, and the actual golden restart completed in 5.5284269389812835 seconds.
